item.content:encoded:
HONG KONG, September 17, 2026 – The enchanting atmosphere of Hong Kong Disneyland Resort (HKDL) is taking a thrillingly dark turn. As “Disney Halloween Time” descends upon the park from September 18 to November 1, 2026, Disney Villains are officially taking over the area, transforming the resort into the ultimate playground for friends and family to gather and dress up together. Packed with wicked fun from new and returning favorites, this year’s celebration offers more ways than ever to share the fun as a group. Guests may enjoy the all-new “Mickey’s Happy Halloween Adventure,” an even grander “Uninvited! A Villains Takeover Party,” Villain Hour encounters, or embrace the mischief with delightful character experiences, devilishly delicious dining, exclusive merchandise and hotel activities.

Whether planning a Halloween outing with friends or a gathering of family, guests can take advantage of different Disney Premiere Access options and two limited-time offers to make the celebration even more magical! Gather a crew of three or more to enjoy 20% off Magic Access memberships and receive complimentary Disney Premier Access for each member when signing up by December 30. Members can enjoy more than 20 exclusive benefits, including unlimited park access, member-only events and exclusive offers throughout the year. There’s never been a better time for guests considering joining Magic Access membership with the limited-time group offer allowing the annual pass to pay for itself in just two visits!

During the Halloween period, Magic Access members can gather their favorite people for a spooky celebration with the “Bring A Friend” Offer, enjoying 40% off regular park tickets for guests visiting together with them.

item.title: Appointment of Independent Non-Executive Directors to Hongkong International Theme Parks Limited
item.dc:creator: The Editors
item.description: HONG KONG, August 31, 2026 — The shareholders of Hongkong International Theme Parks Limited (HKITP), i.e. the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (the Government) and The Walt Disney Company, announced the re-appointment of Mrs. Law Shing Mo Han, Yvonne and the appointment of Mrs. Cheung Vivian Kar-fay, as HKITP’s Independent Non-Executive Directors […]
item.content:encoded:
HONG KONG, August 31, 2026 — The shareholders of Hongkong International Theme Parks Limited (HKITP), i.e. the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (the Government) and The Walt Disney Company, announced the re-appointment of Mrs. Law Shing Mo Han, Yvonne and the appointment of Mrs. Cheung Vivian Kar-fay, as HKITP’s Independent Non-Executive Directors (INEDs) for a term of two years with effect from September 1, 2026.

Mrs. Law is currently the Chairperson of Yinn Advisory Services Limited, and was a partner of Deloitte China. She is a Founding Member and former President of the Association of Women Accountants Hong Kong and former Chairperson of Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants Taxation Committee. She also holds services as member of the Hong Kong Deposit Protection Board and Court Member of the Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

Mrs. Cheung currently serves as Chief Executive Officer of Airport Authority Hong Kong (AAHK) and Director of the Aviation Security Company Limited Board. With more than 30 years of experience in airport management, she has held a number of senior management positions at AAHK, including being appointed as Chief Operating Officer in 2022 and doubled as Acting Chief Executive Officer from June 2024 to April 2025. Mrs. Cheung is also currently Vice Chairman of Zhuhai Airport Group and First Vice President of the Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport Co. Ltd.

Both Mrs. Law and Mrs. Cheung have extensive experience in the business and public sectors which will be beneficial to the strategic and continuous development of HKITP.

HKITP is a joint venture established by the Government and The Walt Disney Company in 1999 for the development and operation of Hong Kong Disneyland Resort. Together with the two INEDs, there are 11 Directors on the Board of HKITP. The full membership list is enclosed in the Annex.

HONG KONG, August 16, 2026 – At D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event, hosted biennially in Anaheim, California, from August 14 – 16, an exciting new chapter in the expansion journey of Hong Kong Disneyland Resort (HKDL) has been unveiled, bringing guests a first look at exclusive Pixar and Marvel-themed experiences coming to the resort. From an all-new Pixar theatrical spectacular debuting in Toy Story Land in the first half of 2027 to a major expansion of the Marvel-themed area anchored by an Avengers attraction, these additions continue to reinforce HKDL as a destination where Disney stories come to life through immersive experiences created exclusively for Hong Kong.

A Brand-new Pixar Adventure Awaits at Toy Story Land

A massive theater space will be unveiled at HKDL’s Toy Story Land for an all-new Pixar-themed theatrical spectacular, inviting guests to explore the newly expanded neighborhood, with their favorite friends from Toy Story, including Woody, Jessie, Buzz Lightyear, Rex and more.

Set to debut in the first half of 2027, this new show available exclusively at HKDL will take Pixar fans and guests of all ages on the ultimate Pixar adventure. “Through beloved Pixar characters, guests will experience an emotional adventure that explores how meaningful friendships are built, nurtured, and celebrated over time.” said Michael Serna, Executive Creative Director, Disney Live Entertainment.

An Original Story and All-New Pixar Character Soon Come to Life

item.title: Hong Kong Disneyland Resort’s Acclaimed Running Event Reimagined as The Brand-new Magic Run Fest – presented by AIA Vitality Registration Opens July 29, 2026
item.dc:creator: The Editors
item.description: Everyone invited to run alongside their favorite Disney friends and Pixar pals through the park’s different enchanted lands
item.content:encoded:
HONG KONG, July 13, 2026 – Hong Kong Disneyland Resort (HKDL) is bringing more magic, excitement, and unforgettable Disney experiences to runners with the launch of the brand-new Magic Run Fest – presented by AIA Vitality, taking place on November 28–29, 2026. Evolving from the resort’s beloved annual 10K Weekend, the reimagined running festival invites guests, diehard fans, casual joggers and avid runners from around the world to embark on magical journeys through the park’s immersive themed lands alongside their favorite Disney friends and Pixar pals.

This running festival will excite all runners with a lineup of themed races designed for participants aged 3 and above, including the Zootopia 10K, Pixar 5K, Duffy and Friends 3K, and Frozen 3K. Along the way, beloved characters will cheer on runners at every turn – bringing the spirit of Disney storytelling and enchanting entertainment throughout every step of the journey. Public registration opens from July 29 to September 27, 2026. Guests who register on or before August 4 can enjoy an early bird offer.

Tim Sypko, Managing Director of Hong Kong Disneyland Resort, said: “Building on the success of our acclaimed 10K Weekend, we are proud to introduce the reimagined Magic Run Fest – presented by AIA Vitality. As we continue to innovate and create new ways for guests to connect with Disney stories, this exciting new chapter of our signature running event brings together wellness, community, and immersive storytelling in a way only Disney can. We look forward to welcoming runners and guests from near and far to create magical memories at HKDL.”

item.title: All-New “Pixar Summer Fest” Debuts at Hong Kong Disneyland Resort
item.dc:creator: The Editors
item.description: Add some Pixar fun to your summer with the most spectacular experiences and the limited-time “Adults at Child Price” offer for Hong Kong residents
item.content:encoded:
HONG KONG, June 11, 2026 — From June 12 to August 31, 2026, the first-ever “Pixar Summer Fest” at Hong Kong Disneyland Resort (HKDL) invites guests of all ages to rediscover the joy of play. Inspired by the heart and imagination of Pixar Animation Studios’ stories, this all-new adventure transforms the park into a vibrant playground where guests can enjoy carefree fun, and play like a kid this summer.

Pixar-themed experiences will unfold across the resort, from signature attractions to stage shows, parades, character encounters, and nighttime spectaculars. Guests are invited to dive into the worlds of Pixar and enjoy immersive fun from day to night, only at HKDL. Beloved pals from Toy Story, The Incredibles, Inside Out, Coco, Up, and more await guests throughout the resort in a variety of experiences, each designed to make this summer truly playful and unforgettable. Along the way, guests can also indulge in themed “eatertainment,” shop trending merchandise, and experience a dynamic entertainment line-up, including the two lively daytime parades and the all-new “Pixar Pals Spectacular,” a dazzling nighttime show that fills the sky with stories of friendship.

Gather your family and friends for joyful shared memories with the “Adults at Child Price” Summer Limited Offer, exclusively for Hong Kong residents. From today to September 20, 2026, guests visiting Hong Kong Disneyland with two or more guests together can enjoy 1 Day General Admission tickets at child price (from HK$499), along with shopping and dining discount vouchers.

item.title: Hong Kong Disneyland Resort Debuts “PlayWell with Disney” Hospital Initiative at The Largest Children’s Hospital in the Greater Bay Area
item.dc:creator: The Editors
item.description: Sharing magic and bringing joy to more child patients across the region
item.content:encoded:
HONG KONG AND SHENZHEN, May 29, 2026 – Hong Kong Disneyland Resort (HKDL) and The Walt Disney Company, with the support of China Soong Ching Ling Foundation and the Shenzhen Project Care Foundation, are bringing HKDL’s award-winning community initiative, “PlayWell with Disney”, to Shenzhen for the first time, expanding child-focused care across the Greater Bay Area.

The initiative aims to support young patients through storytelling, play, and interactive experiences that help ease their hospital journey.

Central to the program is a “Disney V-Care Space” at Shenzhen Children’s Hospital Longhua Campus, the newest and largest Class A tertiary children hospital in the Greater Bay Area. The space integrates Disney storytelling into the healthcare setting to create a more comforting environment for children.

Drawing on Disney China’s experience in supporting pediatric care across the Chinese Mainland, the collaboration enhances services at the Longhua campus. It also marks HKDL’s latest community initiative in the region as it celebrates its 20th anniversary and continues its HK$2.5 million commitment to supporting children in need.

The New “Disney V-Care Space” Uplifts Child Patients’ Spirits in the Greater Bay Area

The V-Care Space initiative, led by Shenzhen Project Care and Shenzhen Children’s Hospital, focuses on creating a more supportive and child centric healthcare experience through enhanced design, services, and compassionate care.

The initiative also aligns with the “Guidelines on Promoting the Development of Child-Friendly Hospitals” issued in 2025 by six national departments, including the National Health Commission.

HONG KONG, MAY 5, 2026 — Calling all families and Pixar Animation Studios fans to plan ahead for a Pixar-filled adventure at the first-ever Pixar Summer Fest at Hong Kong Disneyland Resort (HKDL) from June 12 through August 31, 2026.

This summer, HKDL will transform into a bigger, more dynamic, and high-energy world of Pixar, where favorite Pixar pals come to life across the resort in surprising and interactive ways. From day to night, guests can play in different themed lands, featuring new entertainment high in the sky, new forms of character encounters, and a variety of playful experiences — alongside returning guest-favorite offerings. Pixar Summer Fest fills the celebration with laughter, connection, and play.

Guests can jump into the fun early by securing their visit in advance, with options including Disney Premier Access, to help make the most of every moment. From themed dining experiences to hotel staycations, make sure to plan ahead for a more playful summer. For year‑round magic beyond Pixar Summer Fest, Magic Access unlocks exclusive events and privileges all year long. The all-new Pixar entertainment experience will debut next year as an immersive theatrical adventure, where guests will join beloved Pixar characters on a fun and magical journey that blends real and digital environments, celebrating the power of play and the joy of friendship. Don’t miss the last chance to enjoy the Magic Access Limited‑Time Ticket Upgrade Offer, with 10% off the regular price until June 7.

The all-new “Pixar Pals Spectacular,” featuring glowing drones and projections across the Castle of Magical Dreams and Main Street, U.S.A., celebrates friendship through beloved Pixar stories. item.title: Hong Kong Disneyland Resort Delivers Consecutive Years of Exceptional Results Robust performance reinforces the resort’s position as a Greater Bay Area tourism leader
item.dc:creator: The Editors
item.description: Innovative experiences will be rolling out, including robotic character Olaf starting early May and Pixar Summer Fest from June 12, and continued expansions with new Pixar entertainment experience in 2027 and Marvel-themed experience
item.content:encoded:
April 28, 2026, HONG KONG – Hong Kong Disneyland Resort (HKDL) today shared its business results for the fiscal year 2025 and the latest resort developments. (Note: FY25 began on September 29, 2024 and ended on September 27, 2025)

FY25 marked a milestone year for HKDL as the resort celebrated its 20th anniversary (20A). Building on compelling 20A offerings and effective product and commercial strategies, HKDL delivered consecutive years of top financial performance, achieving near-record revenue, earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) and net profit in the resort’s history.

Park attendance totalled 7.5 million while overall hotel occupancy was around 80%.

Key financial highlights in FY25

* HKDL recorded strong financial results with net profit at HK$536 million, revenue at HK$8,694 million, and EBITDA at HK$1,989 million. These accomplishments are especially notable given the rapid resumption of Hong Kong’s outbound travel, ongoing macroeconomic uncertainty, as well as the extreme weather conditions in Hong Kong in 2025, all of which have influenced travel patterns and visit intent.
* Total attendance was 7.5 million. Per capita guest spending reached historic high with an increase of 2% over prior year.
* Hotel performance remained solid, with overall occupancy increasing six percentage points to 79%.
* By the end of FY25, HKDL had fully repaid the outstanding balance of term loans from its shareholders and is now free of loan for the first time in its history, underscoring the resort’s solid financial position.

item.title: Olaf Delights Guests with Surprise Appearance Starting Early May in World of Frozen at Hong Kong Disneyland Resort
item.dc:creator: The Editors
item.description: Disney friends join the countdown to the finale of the resort’s 20th anniversary celebration across themed lands
item.content:encoded:
HONG KONG, April 15, 2026 — Starting early May, guests can look forward to an all-new, enchanting encounter when they chance upon Olaf in World of Frozen at Hong Kong Disneyland Resort (HKDL). Magically brought to life by Walt Disney Imagineering Research & Development through next-generation robotics utilizing reinforcement learning, the self-walking, free-roaming robotic character will delight guests with surprise greetings as a special ambassador for the kingdom of Arendelle. This immersive, interactive experience invites fans to share joyful moments, laughter, and photo opportunities with Olaf, bringing the heartwarming story of Walt Disney Animation Studios’ Frozen to life like never before.

The magic extends beyond World of Frozen, with a vibrant lineup of new experiences spanning across the resort. In Grizzly Gulch, guests can try their luck at the social-trending “Chip ‘n’ Dale Lucky Nugget Spin” and join “Nuts for Nuggets” with Chip, Dale, and Clarice. At Mystic Point, discovery comes alive as Lord Henry Mystic and Albert the monkey appear in turn to greet guests and invite everyone on an enchanting journey filled with wonders.

Together, these offerings build momentum toward the cannot-miss grand finale of HKDL’s 20th anniversary celebration, delivering all-out excitement as guests are invited to make the most of the final moments before the celebration concludes on June 7. Gather your family and friends and celebrate with the “Happier Together” Advance Purchase Ticket Deal and enjoy 25% off regular-priced 1-Day Tickets when two or more guests visit together, saving up to HK$470 for two!

item.title: Hong Kong Disneyland Celebrates 20 Years of Granting Magical Wishes in First-ever Wish Alumni Reunion
item.dc:creator: The Editors
item.description: Photography wish granted to young Disney fan and HK$800,000 donated to support wishes of children with critical illnesses
item.content:encoded:
HONG KONG, April 13, 2026 – Hong Kong Disneyland Resort (HKDL) hosted its first-ever wish alumni reunion, the “Hong Kong Disneyland 20 Years of Magical Wishes Party,” to mark the milestone of 20 years of collaboration with Make‑A‑Wish® Hong Kong in granting wishes that lift the spirits of hundreds of children battling critical illnesses.

More than 250 guests were invited to this special occasion to celebrate the World Wish Month together, including wish children and HKDL wish alumni who had their Disney wishes come true at HKDL. They celebrated their wish journeys together with their families and wish granters in the reunion.

At the Wishes Party, HKDL also announced a donation of HK$800,000 to Make‑A‑Wish Hong Kong to support wish granting for children with critical illnesses. Part of the donation came from the sale of 1,000 limited‑edition Hong Kong Disneyland 20th Anniversary Celebration vinyl last winter.

Disney fan Ernest’s photography wish comes true at HKDL

Among the wish children is 14‑year‑old Ernest, who overcame kidney disease with a transplant procedure. This year, his wish for a photography experience was granted by HKDL in collaboration with Make‑A‑Wish Hong Kong.

After being diagnosed with kidney disease, Ernest found comfort and encouragement through Disney magic at HKDL, a place he had loved for years. Every visit to HKDL lifted his spirits and created joyful moments that helped him stay positive throughout his treatment journey.

HKDL also inspired his artistic photography dreams. With his health restored, Ernest wished to celebrate this new chapter of life with a professional‑grade camera capturing the magic of HKDL through his own lens.
